summary_md: **UnderTheIndex ([@UnderTheIndex01](https://x.com/UnderTheIndex01/status/2115835235556540486))** summarizes *Agent Memory as Recommendation* ([arXiv 2610.34673](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34673)): **AgentMemRec** selects memories with BM25, embeddings, RRF and a LightGBM ranker without LLM calls, beating A-Mem and HippoRAG 2 by 10–31 points on multi-session LongMemEval and matching a 64-call LLM reranker at 3.2× lower cost.
